welcome.hero_subtitle: SubSnap helps you track all your subscriptions — Netflix, Spotify, Adobe and more — so you know exactly how much you spend every month, with no surprises.
welcome.features_subtitle: Simple, fast and powerful. Nothing unnecessary.
welcome.f1_title: All your subscriptions in one place
welcome.f1_desc: Netflix, Spotify, Adobe CC, and any other service. Add, edit and track everything from a single dashboard.
welcome.f2_desc: See how much you spend monthly and annually. Discover exactly where your money goes and make informed decisions.
welcome.f3_desc: Keep track of renewal dates and billing cycles. Always stay one step ahead of deadlines.
welcome.f4_desc: Your data is protected with secure authentication. Only you can see your financial information.
welcome.how_subtitle: Get started in less than a minute.
welcome.s1_desc: Register for free with email and password. No credit card required.
welcome.s2_desc: Enter the services you use, the cost and the renewal frequency.
welcome.s3_desc: View statistics and take control of your recurring expenses.
welcome.cta_subtitle: Create your account for free and start tracking your subscriptions today.
